sources.name: NASA POWER daily (AG community)
sources.what: Daily max/min/mean air temperature, humidity, wind at 2 m and 10 m, solar radiation, corrected precipitation
sources.used_for: Rotation Replay weather, reference ET, heat, frost and wind days

sources.name: JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO Mascon RL06.3 (CRI filtered)
sources.what: Monthly terrestrial water storage anomaly (liquid water equivalent)
sources.used_for: Regional aquifer / water-storage trend in the water outlook

sources.name: SRTM Global 1 arc second DEM (SRTMGL1 v3)
sources.used_for: Field slope and cold-air low-spot flag

sources.name: SSURGO via Soil Data Access
sources.what: Map units, components and horizons: AWC, AWS 0–100 cm, organic matter, K factor, hydrologic group, WEG/WEI, drainage, restrictions
sources.used_for: Soil water holding, erodibility, soil-health inputs and neighbour matching

sources.name: Crop Sequence Boundaries 2018–2025 (rev23)
sources.what: Field polygons with the Cropland Data Layer crop for each year
sources.used_for: Demo field outlines, crop history, detected rotation, neighbour pool

sources.name: Quick Stats
sources.what: Survey yields (irrigated / non-irrigated), prices received, acres planted
sources.resolution: Finney County, SW Kansas district, Kansas
sources.used_for: Yields, prices and the local-market check

sources.name: OpenET Ensemble
sources.provider: OpenET (NASA, USGS, DRI, EDF, Google and partners)
sources.what: Actual evapotranspiration, ensemble of 6 satellite models
sources.used_for: Replay validation and neighbours' real water use

sources.name: PRISM daily (4 km)
sources.provider: PRISM Climate Group, Oregon State University
sources.used_for: 1991–2020 climate normals vs 2016–2025, ground-based check of POWER

sources.name: USGS Water Data APIs — groundwater field measurements
sources.what: Depth to water below land surface at monitoring wells (USGS, KGS and Kansas DWR wells)
sources.used_for: Local aquifer trend near each field

sources.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Penman-Monteith, crop coefficients)
sources.what: Reference ET method and crop coefficients (Kc)
sources.used_for: Reference ET and crop water demand in the Replay

sources.name: Glean water-budget model (FAO-56)
sources.what: Simulated yield, water use and soil outputs built from the inputs above
sources.used_for: Rotation Replay results and the calendar
